description: Delivered 24 October 1970; registered 12 November 1970 as CCCP-87774 to the North Caucasus Civil Aviation Directorate at Krasnodar-Pashkovsky; transferred to the Aktyubinsk Higher Civil Aviation Flying School 6 April 1979; struck off 25 December 1987 on expiry of service life; plinthed beside Aktyubinsk (now Aktobe) airport; year_built from the registry's delivery date; the true build date is not separately stated
